Erfar the Silvertongue

Biography

Erfar the Silvertongue governs Gipath’s village and presents himself as its devoted elected leader. He proclaims Zak the Chosen and puts that supposed destiny to practical use, assigning dangerous errands while promising honour and hospitality. His speeches conceal a much more personal interest in the island. [1, 2]

Conspiracy and return

Zak exposes Erfar’s involvement in the plot against him. Estera recalls that Erfar arrived as an adult, claiming to have escaped brigands. In Suslanger, Erfar reveals his real origin and his search for the meteorite. Disguised as Brother Faceless, he gains Zak’s trust again and arranges an ambush near the Portal. [3, 4, 5, 6]
